name: Love of Curse
source:
Main character is taken to the dark fantasy world on his 20th birthday due to a curse contract between father and his mistress. Protagonist gets to a large mansion of the Demon Lord under care of Demon Lord son Alex. Their strange communal life begins in this world of ghosts, skeletons, goblins and youkai.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
